name: Primer
description: Interactive AI experience platform combining voice, visuals, and autonomous decision-making

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Your OpenAI API key (required). Get one at https://platform.openai.com/api-keys

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: Google OAuth Client ID for authentication. Create at https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials

NEXTAUTH_URL.description: Your app URL (e.g., https://your-app-name.herokuapp.com). Set this AFTER deployment - see README for instructions.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Anthropic API key (optional). Get one at https://console.anthropic.com/

USER_ROLE_MAPPINGS.description: JSON mapping of email to roles, e.g. {"you@example.com":["ADMIN"]}
